name: Scenario: level run
description: Loads a level and drives player 1 through it with the scenario-level-run driver: movement, jump, fire, special, melee, one forced death and a respawn, the level's own mechanics, and the exit, or a timeout with a progress figure. Utility Mod's disableEnemySpawn is off for the run. The run's GameObject must be tagged Unpausable, and 3 s after a run that reaches the exit the level must still be finished with its outcome held, never run (not switching level, its outcome timer held), the save's start level for the territory must be the one it had at the load, and the bro rescues the run makes (Intro level 1's cage on the default route among them) must leave the progress's freed-bro count and unlocked bros as they were. Needs a save slot holding a campaign. survey=true scans the level instead of driving it. The default level, Intro level 1, finishes in about 25 s with five enemies, a door, a ladder and a cage.

campaign.description: Campaign index, as go_to_level takes it

timeoutSec.description: Driving budget in seconds; the poll waits 600 s in all, so keep it under about 480

requireMechanics.description: Comma list of mechanic kinds the run must exercise, e.g. wormTunnel,zipline

survey.description: true to scan and report the level's layout and mechanics without driving
